rules.statement: The first bond is not an essential part of the cause of action in a hypothecary action, and can be produced in evidence to prove the debt.
rules.supporting_quote: "How the debt was created is for this purpose immaterial and the first bond is not therefore an essential part of the cause of action. It can without being pleaded be produced in evidence to prove the debt."

meta.parties: The Bank of Ceylon, Jaffna v. Chelliahpillai
